articles.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns

articles.author: Anthony Ha

articles.title: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings

articles.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
articles.description: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec, Lucas Ropek, Rebecca Bellan
